claim: In mm/memory.c, thp_swapin_suitable_orders() checks zswap_all_present() across candidate orders 2 and 4 instead of unconditionally returning 0 when zswap is active, and do_swap_page() routes orders > 1 directly to swapin_sync(). In mm/zswap.c, zswap_all_present() verifies contiguous slot residency under RCU, and zswap_load() uses two-phase commit subpage decompression into kmap_local_folio subpage offsets, atomically installing all PTEs via set_ptes() under a single PTL hold.
falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, missing order-0 fallback, or broken RCU presence checking. Correctness gates, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.
